title: Metal Fabrication Buying Guides & Articles | NovoTech
meta_description: 45 buying guides from NovoTech's technicians: press brakes, lasers, shears, band saws, plate rollers, tube benders, ironworkers, presses, grinders, CNC machines, rebar and window machinery.
intro: What we explain to customers before they buy — how the machines work, how capacity is rated, which options matter and which do not — written by NovoTech's sales engineers and technicians from years of installing machines in Canada. Each guide sits at the bottom of its product page, next to the machines it describes.
